title: Coherence of the open pullback cube
statement: Let $f:X\to S$, $f\prime:X\prime\to S\prime$, $g:S\prime\to S$, $g\prime:X\prime\to X$ be a commutative scheme square [def-pc-scheme], so $g\prime\gg f=f\prime\gg g$. Let $V\subset S$, $V\prime\subset S\prime$ with $V\prime\subset g^{-1}V$, put $U=f^{-1}V$, $U\prime=f\prime{}^{-1}V\prime$, and let $j:U\prime\to U$ commute both with the inclusions and with the restricted arrows $f_0,f_0\prime,g_0$. Give every scheme its derived category [def-pc-derived-category]. For $M\in D(\mathcal O_S)$, let $q:Lf\prime{}^*Lg^*\cong Lg\prime{}^*Lf^*$ and $q_0:Lf_0\prime{}^*Lg_0^*\cong Lj^*Lf_0^*$ be the pinned composition square comparisons [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. Write $d_f,d_{f\prime},d_g,d_{g\prime}$ for the constructed open pullback squares [def-pc-t2-open-pullback-square-iso], and $R_S,R_{X\prime}$ for open restriction [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. Then $q_0(R_SM)\gg Lj^*(d_f(M))\gg d_{g\prime}(Lf^*M)=Lf_0\prime{}^*(d_g(M))\gg d_{f\prime}(Lg^*M)\gg R_{X\prime}(q(M))$. No direct images, counits, cartesianness, or base-change arrows occur.

proof.text: Use the associativity clause of the exact composition family selected in exists_derivedPullbackComposition. Extend each two-arrow comparison by an equality transport to a named composite; substituting those named composites and cancelling the associativity transport proves the componentwise three-arrow identity.

For the six paths j,U inclusion,f; j,f restricted,V inclusion; f prime restricted,g restricted,V inclusion; U prime inclusion,g prime,f; U prime inclusion,f prime,g; and f prime restricted,V prime inclusion,g, transport their total composite to j followed by U inclusion followed by f using the five commuting-face equalities. Postcompose both cube paths by the invertible comparison from the U prime inclusion,g prime,f path to this total pullback. Apply the preceding three-arrow identity on each path and cancel successive comparison inverses. Both sides become f prime restricted pullback of the g restricted,V inclusion comparison followed by the comparison into the same total pullback.

Identify the pinned square comparison with the componentwise transported composition comparison. Expand each constructed open square into inverse open comparison, the ordinary pullback square, and the terminal open comparison. Cancel the open comparisons on U and V prime. Naturality moves the remaining inverse open comparison on V to the front of the restricted square and the open comparison on U prime to the end of the outer square. Precompose and postcompose the ordinary cube identity from the preceding step by these common factors. This proves the displayed identity for every object, including zero objects and empty opens.
